title: Plugin Approval
description: Vendor approval for an Agent Plugin (agent-plugins.org) in the AI Registry

source.description: Location of the plugin folder in a git repository

url.description: Git repository URL containing the plugin

path.description: Path within the repository to the plugin folder (containing plugin.json). Omit if the plugin is at the repository root.

installConfigs.description: Tool-specific installation configurations. Omit if no tool-specific configuration is needed.

tool.description: Tool ID this config targets (must match a tool in the AI Registry)

installUrl.description: Deep-link URL for one-click install (tool-specific protocol)
